This suggests using substitution. Let $u = 7 - 7x^2$, so $du = -14x \, dx$. Substituting, the integral simplifies to $\int \frac{1}{3} u^{-2/3} \, du$. Integrating $u^{-2/3}$ yields $u^{1/3}$, so the result is $\sqrt[3]{7 - 7x^2} + C$.
